headlines.text: It was 2020 when Omega & Page vs. The Natural Nightmares put the AEW World Tag Team Titles on the line, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.31. For The Natural Nightmares, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. This stood as the 10th match in AEW World Tag Team Titles history ? a nice marker in that championship's story. A well-worked opener with real family drama in the background ? QT Marshall's crush on Allie kept things personal on the outside, while inside the ring, Dustin Rhodes turned back the clock with an impressive hurricanrana before the champions closed it out with their Buckshot/V-Trigger combo.

Rewind to 2023, when the AEW TNT Title found a new home as Luchasaurus vs. Wardlow battled it out, appearing on Collision, rated 5.15 ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. In the first-ever match on AEW Collision, Christian Cage's interference ? smashing a ringside camera over Wardlow's head ? let Luchasaurus steal the TNT Championship, a shock title win nobody in the arena saw coming.
Flash back to 2026, when Mercedes Mone vs. Hazuki met in an Owen Hart Tournament Match on Dynamite, rated 8.94 ? a genuine showstealer.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2022, when it was the first-ever encounter between Darby Allin and Bobby Fish, closing out the card as the main event on Rampage, rated 7.16 ? a good, competitive contest.
On a Wednesday in 2020, back when Ricky Starks laced up for their first AEW match against Cody, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.21.
Flash back to 2023, when Bullet Club Gold & Joe wasted no time making an impression, debuting right in the main event as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.74 ? a solid showing.
